ability.name: Incandescent Blaze
ability.effect:
For the rest of the turn:
• Double the Attacks characteristic of this unit's **Roaring Fyrestream**.
• This unit's **Roaring Fyrestream** has a Damage characteristic of 3.

ability.name: Peerless Lineage
ability.effect: You can pick another eligible unit to be a second target of that **^^Rampage^^** ability. If that ability requires a roll, you must roll for each target.

ability.name: Thickened Scales
ability.effect: Subtract 1 from the Rend characteristic of weapons used for attacks that target this unit.
